title:
Common base type for all configurable types.

Typically kind of Configurable (i.e. whether it is Identifiable, Singleton etc) matches kind of Config. However this
is not strictly required. E.g. Configurable could be Identifiable but Config could be Singleton or per sub-type.
However users of this type should not be concerned by this implementation detail and should never use corresponding
Config sub-type. Rather all usage should be limited to Configurable#config.

When mixing in this type, along with AclEnabled and/or Versionable, this type should be mixed in first, followed
by AclEnabled then Versionable (as appropriate).

@see Config
